When do Americans shower, groom, and get ready?

On an average weekday, the share of Americans on personal care peaks at 7:00 AM, when 12.0% of people age 15 and older (about 30.2 million) are on personal care. On weekends it peaks at 8:00 AM (9.3%). Averaged over all days, Americans spend 50 min a day on personal care.

What it includes

Average time per weekday, for the activities in this group that take the most time.

  • Washing, dressing and grooming oneself: 41 min a day
  • Health-related self care: 4 min a day
  • Sleeplessness: 4 min a day

About these numbers

Estimates come from all 258,954 diaries in the American Time Use Survey (Bureau of Labor Statistics and Census Bureau), 2003–2025, weighted to the U.S. civilian population age 15 and older and pooled across years. Times are local clock time. Counts are people on an average day of that type, not a live count. Weekdays are Monday–Friday. How the estimates work.
